item.title: Unrecyclable: Look Again — Final Weekend — Thu Aug 27, 12:00 PM — The Space
item.description:
For nearly two years, Montclair artist Andrew Borg refused to throw away the packaging that carries no recycling code. Unrecyclable: Look Again turns that collection into eleven wall-mounted assemblages, several lit by ultraviolet spotlights. Originally set to close August 22, the show has been held over for a final weekend after strong turnout at its closing Assemblage Lab. Free admission; works available for purchase. item.title: Finding Paddy — Wed Sep 9, 7:00 PM — The Clairidge
item.description:
Montclair filmmaker Steve McCarthy looks at the life of his friend FDNY Captain Patrick “Paddy” Brown, after he dies in the World Trade Center on 9/11.
